title: Beyond the Final Layer: Intermediate Representations for Better Multilingual Calibration in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.03136v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Confidence calibration, the alignment of a model's predicted confidence with its actual accuracy, is crucial for the reliable deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this critical property remains largely under-explored in multilingual contexts. In this work, we conduct the first large-scale, systematic studies of multilingual calibration across six model families and over 100 languages, revealing that non-English languages suffer from systematically worse calibration. To diagnose this, we investigate the model's internal representations and find that the final layer, biased by English-centric training, provides a poor signal for multilingual confidence. In contrast, our layer-wise analysis uncovers a key insight that late-intermediate layers consistently offer a more reliable and better-calibrated signal. Building on this, we introduce a suite of training-free methods, including Language-Aware Confidence Ensemble (LACE)

translated_title: 超越最终层：利用中间表示实现大语言模型更好的多语言校准
translated_abstract: 置信度校准，即模型的预测置信度与其实际准确率之间的对齐，对于大语言模型（LLM）的可靠部署至关重要。然而，这一关键特性在多语言场景中在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们对六个模型家族、超过100种语言的多语言校准进行了首次大规模系统性研究，揭示了非英语语言普遍存在系统性更差的校准问题。为了诊断这一问题，我们研究了模型的内部表示，发现受以英语为中心的训练偏差影响，最终层为多语言置信度提供的信号较差。相比之下，我们的逐层分析揭示了一个关键洞察：中后期中间层始终能提供更可靠、校准更好的信号。基于这一发现，我们提出了一系列无需训练的方法，包括语言感知置信度集成（LACE）。
tldr: 该论文首次大规模系统研究了大语言模型的多语言校准问题，发现中后期中间层的表示比受英语中心训练偏差影响的最终层能提供更可靠的多语言置信度信号，并据此提出了包括语言感知置信度集成（LACE）在内的无需训练的方法来改善非英语语言的校准。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale systematic study of multilingual calibration in LLMs, revealing that late-intermediate layers provide more reliable multilingual confidence signals than the English-biased final layer, and introduces training-free methods including Language-Aware Confidence Ensemble (LACE) to improve calibration for non-English languages.
